hooks.text: 最多4名患者在线合作逃离诊所，可用语音协调，也能互相破坏、救人和打架制造混乱。
hooks.excerpt: Here, you and up to 3 of your brainless loyal friends play as patients, fighting staff and other patients while stumbling into all sorts of unexpected situations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 实验药丸会随机赋予无敌怪物、激光复视或巨大缩小等能力，并可能失控。
hooks.excerpt: Take pills and get abilities : Bipolar force is an invulnerable monster, then a helpless rag! Laser astigmatism — two sights, one laser… Where will he shoot? Stendhal syndrome — are you looking at a painting? Now you're hysterical and destroying everything around you! Alice's syndrome is either tiny or gigantic — have time to adjust!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 逃生地图由随机房间拼成，包含重力变化、陷阱和移动墙，一次误操作即可拖垮整队。
hooks.excerpt: Locations are randomly generated from rooms with changing gravity, traps, moving walls, and other "pleasant" surprises.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
